reason: Evidence indicates this is a DeepSeek Harness native plugin that adds an in-process HTML review/annotation workflow, including `html_review_*` model tools for starting sessions, claiming handoffs, fetching sessions, and finalizing edited output. The plugin’s user-facing role is coordinating local review workflows for agents rather than providing general content search or standalone editing outside the harness context.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生的 Anno 集成，开启本地 HTML 评审服务并暴露 `html_review_*` 工具，用于在会话中启动评审、接收/认领交接并注册最终的注释与修改结果。
summaries.en: This plugin provides native Anno integration for DeepSeek Harness by adding an in-process local HTML review service with `html_review_*` tools so agents can start reviews, claim handoffs, retrieve sessions, and register finalized annotated output.

capabilities: local loopback HTTP review server for model-driven HTML review sessions
persistent on-disk session and review artifact storage
model tool registration for session start/claim/list/finalize flow
automatic handoff injection into agent follow-up flow
agent-facing review artifact retrieval and editing pipeline

reasons.code: The plugin is documented as an in-process HTML review service for local-only operation on 127.0.0.1, which introduces server/file-system coupled execution risk at the host level.
It persists review sessions and versioned reviewed HTML outputs in a local data directory, meaning file writes are part of normal operation.
It registers workflow tools (`html_review_start_session`, `html_review_claim_handoff`, `html_review_register_final`, etc.) that can drive agent actions automatically via follow-up messages.
Package metadata declares a DSH bundle patch and host-side binding (`dsh` bundle, `main` entry in `lib/index.js`), confirming direct harness/runtime integration.
